content.short: Netzprints is a utility NFT project providing secure pass access to decentralized VPN services on TON.
content.description: Netzprints is a pioneering utility-centric NFT project on the TON blockchain that bridges digital art with essential internet security. Each Netzprints NFT serves as a permanent digital pass, granting its holder lifetime discounts and premium access to the NETZ.RUN decentralized VPN network. The project focuses on empowering users with secure and private internet connectivity while offering the benefits of provable digital ownership. Netzprints is a key example of how NFT technology can be utilized to provide long-term access to critical decentralized infrastructure and privacy-focused services on the TON network.
content.meta: Secure your internet with Netzprints NFTs on TON. Lifetime VPN discounts and more on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
